anchor: The SMPTE broadcast color-bar test card and the scrolling FAST electronic program guide — the moment Latin America's free-to-air television, the telenovela-and-football signal that ran the region for a century, became an IP grid of free ad-supported channels. Broadcast-condensed chyron type over a warm reading stock, in the saturated bar colors of a tuned-in signal.
rationale: The corpus's signature is a region that leapt from broadcast straight to IP — skipping the addressable-cable step — so the connected living room arrived as a *signal* before it arrived as a market. The world is therefore the television signal itself: the color-bar test card's amber/vermilion/cyan/blue/magenta become the five source tiers; a condensed grotesque carries the broadcast-chyron headings; a warm serif holds the long reading. The palette is deliberately the saturated, tropical-broadcast opposite of the cool 'Dotted-Quad RFC' monospace of the adjacent IPv4/CTV corpus and the warm-print 'AdEx Ledger' of the India corpus — three adtech worlds, three distinct signals.
